decks.notes: This deck revolves around assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game quickly and efficiently. It utilizes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana for the combo, while also including disruption in the form of Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. Thassa's Oracle is the win condition of choice, with The Fantasticar providing additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces, protect them from disruption, and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck revolves around assembling the combo of The Fantasticar and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate infinite mana and draw your entire deck with Thought Monitor and Thoughtcast. Utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble to fuel The Fantasticar's ability, and playing disruption like Sink into Stupor and Force of Will to protect your combo. The mana acceleration provided by cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, along with Urza's Saga, Ancient Tomb, and City of Traitors, help set up the combo quickly for a powerful win condition.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and countermagic like Force of Will, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by making timely plays and denying the opponent the resources they need to recover, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of aggression and disruptive elements. The key strategy is to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's plans, ultimately leading to victory through attrition.

This combo-reanimator deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and ensure the combo can go off smoothly. With a mix of graveyard manipulation and fast mana acceleration, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures as quickly as possible.

The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to play aggressively and disrupt your opponent's game plan while maintaining control of the board. This is achieved through a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out, disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze, and powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. By leveraging these tools, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize creatures with disruptive abilities such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent, while also using cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Elite Spellbinder to control the board. The deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure with its aggressive creatures and disruptive elements, preventing the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. The inclusion of cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland further disrupt the opponent's strategy, allowing the deck to maintain control and take the lead in the game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Doomsday combo using cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and The Fantasticar to generate mana and card advantage. The key goal is to cast Doomsday, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, and then use Thassa's Oracle as a win condition. The deck also includes disruption cards like Daze and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's plays and ensure the combo can be executed successfully. The main strategy revolves around efficiently casting Doomsday and winning the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this deck is to have strong control over the game using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, card draw, and powerful creatures like Monastery Mentor and Murktide Regent. With cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to control the opponent's resources while generating card advantage for itself. The inclusion of cards like Wrath of the Skies and Stifle further adds to the deck's ability to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow and methodical manner.

The focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition, the deck can slow down the opponent's strategy and remove key threats. Meanwhile, cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Aether Vial allow for efficient creature deployment and equipment tutoring, adding to the aggressive nature of the deck. With a mix of disruptive elements and efficient beaters, the deck aims to out-value and out-tempo the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The Fantasticar is utilized for additional card draw and filtering, while cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will help protect the combo. The mana base is designed to support casting the necessary spells quickly and efficiently, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. The goal is to set up the combo as quickly as possible and prevent opponents from disrupting it, ultimately securing victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer cards to consistently search for and trade artifacts like Lotus Petal, Mishra's Bauble, and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage. The deck also utilizes the synergy between cards like Urza's Saga and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to tutor for powerful artifacts like The Filigree Sylex and Phyrexian Dragon Engine. The inclusion of cards like Loki, God of Mischief and Legion Extruder provide additional utility and disruption to control the board while assembling the combo pieces.

The key concept of this deck revolves around using the synergy between cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Mishra's Bauble, and Urza's Saga to generate card advantage and mana acceleration. The deck aims to quickly assemble a combo involving The Fantasticar and other artifacts to achieve a powerful win condition. With ample control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor, as well as acceleration from cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while building its own board presence to execute its combo efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive cards like Stifle. The key strategy revolves around using Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent. Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provides additional card draw and board presence, while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful threat. The deck also includes versatile removal options like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as protection with Force of Will and Force of Negation. The goal is to stall the game until the opponent runs out of resources, then close out the game with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures to disrupt opponents while efficiently using resources to maintain board control. It generates advantage through card advantage engines like Yorion, Sky Nomad and Aether Vial, while leveraging disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition to disrupt opponent's game plan. By combining efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares with strong threats like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, this deck aims to pressure opponents quickly and efficiently, creating a strong tempo advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly getting big threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield through cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It utilizes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Omniscience to help cheat these big creatures into play, while also packing interaction with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game, taking advantage of the combo potential of its cards. It is designed to be fast and efficient, aiming to win the game in just a few turns.

This deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining control with counter spells and removal. The key idea is to use cheap spells like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's plays while developing a board presence with threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. By efficiently controlling the game and pressuring the opponent's life total, the deck aims to overwhelm them before they can recover. The deck also utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig for answers and maintain card advantage.
